statement.p: A certain magical substance that is used to make solid magical spheres costs \$400 per cubic foot. The power of a magical sphere depends on its surface area, and a magical sphere can be sold for \$50 per square foot of surface area. If you are manufacturing such a sphere, what size should you make them to maximize your profit per sphere?
Note 1: the formulas for the volume and surface area of a sphere of radius r are V=\frac{4\pi}{3}r^3 and A=4\pi r^2 respectively.
Note 2: on a real exam you would be expected to justify that the answer above is actually a maximum, rather than, say a minimum.
